item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Preserve an immutable highlight source","mechanism":"Separate the original annotation evidence from its current location so remapping never overwrites what the reader selected.","implementation":"Store highlighted text, revision ID, original range, surrounding context, and note ID; retain the source revision or an immutable passage snapshot.","check":"After multiple revisions and remappings, retrieve the exact original selection and revision without consulting the latest document.","risk":"Revision retention requires storage limits and explicit document-deletion policies."},{"action":"Track passage identity through recorded edits","mechanism":"Persistent passage identifiers and recorded edit operations distinguish actual moves from unrelated passages with identical wording.","implementation":"Assign passage IDs; preserve IDs on moves, issue new IDs on copies, and record range transformations and revision links.","check":"Move a paragraph containing a highlight; verify its note follows with an inspectable operation chain. Copying must not duplicate the attachment.","risk":"Imported revisions may lack trustworthy edit history; text changes still require review."},{"action":"Generate candidates without forcing an attachment","mechanism":"Whole-document exact search recovers potential moved passages; context and section structure help expose repeated-text ambiguity.","implementation":"Find all exact occurrences, then rank using saved context and headings. Keep similarity-only results as suggestions, never automatic attachments.","check":"For identical repeated sentences, display competing locations unless identity evidence resolves them. Find a moved paragraph even outside its former section.","risk":"A unique exact occurrence alone does not prove passage identity."},{"action":"Compare passages before accepting changed text","mechanism":"An explicit review gate prevents small wording changes from silently transferring notes to passages with different meanings.","implementation":"Show revision-labeled old and proposed passages side by side with token differences and surrounding context; require confirmation when selected text changes.","check":"Change “must” to “must not”; verify the change is visible, attachment remains pending, and the original note stays untouched.","risk":"Diffs expose wording changes but cannot establish semantic equivalence."},{"action":"Keep missing passages accessible with their notes","mechanism":"Detached annotations preserve useful notes without pretending that deleted text still has a location in the current document.","implementation":"Provide distinct deleted, unresolved, and ambiguous states. Mark deletion only with supporting revision evidence; show original text and an old-revision link.","check":"Delete a highlighted paragraph; its note remains searchable and readable without highlighting an unrelated replacement passage.","risk":"Failure to find a match alone cannot establish deletion."},{"action":"Record and reverse reader-approved reattachments","mechanism":"A versioned attachment history makes manual decisions traceable without replacing the annotation’s original evidence.","implementation":"Let readers choose a candidate, select another passage, or leave the note detached; record destination revision, range, decision, and prior attachment.","check":"Resolve repeated boilerplate manually, inspect the recorded choice, then undo it. A subsequent edit must trigger validation against its own revision.","risk":"Reader approval may be mistaken; never treat it as permanent proof."},{"action":"Test remapping as revision sequences","mechanism":"Fixture-based state transitions catch false attachments that isolated string-matching tests miss, including stale decisions against newer revisions.","implementation":"Create fixtures for repeated sentences, moved paragraphs, meaning-changing edits, and deletion; assert attachment state, retained source, and evidence after each revision.","check":"Reject silent similarity-based transfers, unresolved duplicate selection, lost deleted notes, and confirmations applied to a revision newer than the reviewed candidate.","risk":"Passing fixtures demonstrates covered behavior, not correctness for every document."}],"abstention_reason":""}
